text:
maria: Quick thought — can we add 'presets' when creating experiments? like canary-quick (1%, 5m) / steady (5%, 1h) — saves the common config copy/paste
kevin: yes, UX-wise a dropdown would help. Also need to ensure quota enforcement on the routing side
sam: +1. Maybe presets map to routing policies + telemetry hooks. e.g. preset -> {seed, ramp, metric hooks}
irene: important: presets must not bypass guard thresholds. can't have a preset that disables SLA fallback or quota checks
maria: agree. my idea: presets are client-side templates but server validates and normalizes them before create
kevin: sketch of server payload we could auto-fill from a preset:
```
{
  "seed": 42,
  "variants": [{"id":"control","weight":95},{"id":"canary","weight":5}],
  "ramp": [{"duration":"5m","traffic":1},{"duration":"55m","traffic":5}],
  "guards": {"qps_per_variant": 100, "latency_p90_ms": 1200}
}
```
kevin: server should enforce per-tenant QPS caps and per-variant QPS and reject preset if it conflicts with committed capacity
sam: telemetry note: a preset should auto-attach a default eval set + baseline metrics (latency, error-rate, quality evals) so console shows regressions immediately
irene: also add audit metadata: preset_id, preset_snapshot, who launched, and whether it was edited post-launch
maria: small UX detail: show a preview diff between preset defaults and the edited experiment before submit
kevin: API idea: experiments.create accepts `preset_id` and an optional `preset_overrides` map; backend returns `preset_validation` block in response with warnings
sam: +1, and telemetry should emit a `preset_applied` event with experiment_id and seed
irene: security: presets that originate from shared org templates should be flagged; only owners can publish org-wide presets
maria: ops question — if preset ramps faster than capacity, should we auto-slow the ramp or reject? prefer reject with a clear message
kevin: agree reject is safer. we could offer an auto-adjust option later (with a checkbox) that rewrites ramp to safe values
sam: for console, display an inline guard banner when preset touches guarded fields: "This preset requests X but your Dedicated capacity max is Y"
kevin: also edge-case: variant seeding and entropy. presets should define seed but allow `randomize_seed=true` at launch
ire: (irene) — typo: randomize_seed flag name nit: use `seed_mode: random|fixed` instead
maria: nice catch. we'll standardize naming in the API doc
maria: @deploy-bot can we do a small smoke run in staging with the new preset?
deploy-bot: started canary-preset-smoke on staging (job id: canary-smoke-171851). will run 15m and report results to #eng-platform
kevin: follow-ups: I can wire the console dropdown and preview diff — will add `preset_catalog` endpoint to fetch org and personal presets
sam: I'll hook telemetry events (`preset_applied`, `preset_validation`, `preset_rejected`) into the eval pipeline
ire: i'll implement server validation + audit logging. will also add a flag to force-apply (admin only) for emergency rollouts
maria: action list: irene server validation & audit, kevin console UI & preset_catalog, sam telemetry & eval hooks, maria UX copy + presets doc. target: minimal MVP with two presets in 2 sprints :rocket:
kevin: cool. I'll post API draft in #eng-platform tomorrow and ping infra for quota checks
maria: thanks all. small follow-up: please add example preset JSON to the docs repo and link in the console tooltip
kevin: will do
